complete_examples.text: The results demonstrated that by the use of grouting or under-sleeper pads, the stiffness variation along the track can be modified, and accordingly the wheel/rail contact force can be considerably reduced.

Additionally, using grouting [108,109], polymers [110,111], tire-derived aggregates (TDA) [112,113] and under sleeper pads (USP) [114], under ballast mats (UBM) [114,115] are also common methods to alleviate the stiffness irregularity along the track.
